summary.text: Adam Niemerg is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 102nd District, serving since January 2021, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His legislature biography says he is a Teutopolis native who lives in rural Dieterich in Effingham County, attended Lake Land College, and earned a bachelor's degree in history from Eastern Illinois University.
It says he was previously a senior claims adjuster for Country Financial with 12 years of experience.
